variation: Standing light-dumbbell Cuban press, upright row then external rotation then overhead press, reversing each segment.
camera: Fixed frontal slight three-quarter full body portrait with overhead clearance.

beats.label: Set up
beats.cue: Stand tall; hold light weights at thighs.
beats.pose: Arms down; light dumbbells in front of thighs.

beats.label: Lead with elbows
beats.cue: Raise elbows, keeping weights below them.
beats.pose: Elbows at shoulder height, upper arms out; forearms point down, weights at lower chest.

beats.label: Rotate upward
beats.cue: Rotate weights upward without moving elbows.
beats.pose: Upper arms unchanged, elbows bent ninety degrees, forearms upright.

beats.label: Press overhead
beats.cue: Press overhead without arching your back.
beats.pose: Arms extended overhead, ribs down, light weights above shoulders.

beats.label: Lower to shoulder height
beats.cue: Lower slowly into the upright forearm position.

beats.label: Reverse the rotation
beats.cue: Rotate down, then lower toward your thighs.
beats.transition: Return to frame1 completes the controlled lowering segment.
